content:
sylvie: Quick FYI0linkcheck started surfacing a set of broken fragments after the content import. Mostly anchors with mixed unicode and punctuation. Example: `# Client: ratelimits` vs `# Client : rate limits` generated different slugs and 3rd-party links 404.

omar: Reproduced locally. Docusaurus keeps punctuation in place for some runs; mkdocs strips it. I ran `node tools/slug-diff.js` and it lists ~27 mismatches across the site.

jasmin: I pushed PR 5120 that normalizes headings by NFC, strips soft-hyphen and zero-width spaces, collapses multiple punctuation into a single hyphen, and treats inline code as atomic. Tests included.

linkchecker-bot: linkcheck: branch/pr/5120 4 broken anchors remaining. Report: https://ci.redwood-inference.local/links/5120

rolf: Can we avoid touching source files wildly? Suggest emitting a redirects.json for detected variants and rolling the normalization behind a flag so we can test on staging first.

sylvie: +1. Add a collector `scripts/collect_anchor_variants.py --emit` that scans git history and linkcheck logs, outputs candidate redirects. If <100 entries we auto-emit; otherwise we'll prioritize fixes.

omar: I added the collector and a config flag `slugNormalization: { enabled: false }` in docusaurus config. PR 5120 defaults to false. Perf impact negligible (~10ms/page).

jasmin: Note: one gotcha: pages with explicit frontmatter `title:` and a different H1 produced duplicate slugs under the new logic. I added a regression test and changed logic to prefer explicit `slug:` frontmatter when present; otherwise derive from H1.

linkchecker-bot: build: staging/docs (after update) 0 broken anchors. Remaining issues are in vendor-imported files with hard-to-edit chars.

rolf: For the vendor files we'll emit 8 targeted redirects and document them in the changelog. Also ping support to watch 404s for 72h after deploy.

sylvie: Plan sounds good. Merge sequence: small trim PR -> PR 5120 with collector (flag off) -> redirects PR if collector finds small list -> enable normalization on staging -> full linkcheck -> enable flag in prod during quiet window.

ci-bot: preview: https://deploy-preview-5120.docs.redwood-inference.com/ (staging)

omar: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 (WIP). Please add cases if you hit other funky unicode sequences.

jasmin: Thanks all. Ill follow up with a short migration note and point to the redirects.json for support triage.
